title: Top 15 car producing countries by annual motor vehicle production, 1950 to 2025
subtitle: 1950 to 2025
hook: Watch how global automobile manufacturing shifted across the world over seven decades.
setup: This race tracks annual motor vehicle production volumes for the top countries from 1950 through 2025.

sequence.text: In 1950, the United States stood as the top car producer with 8,005,859 vehicles.
Germany jumped to second place in 1960 with a production volume of 2,056,149.
Japan claimed the top spot in 1980, producing 11,042,884 vehicles.
Turkey entered the ranking in 2000 with a production volume of 1,077,190 vehicles.
China reached a massive production volume of 31,281,592 vehicles by 2024.

ending: China ultimately maintained its dominant position in global vehicle manufacturing through the final years.
